newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Valuation New Zealand to become Crown company.
newsitem.headline: Valuation New Zealand to become Crown company.

text.p: Valuation New Zealand is to become a Crown-owned company, Associate Treasurer Tuariki Delamere said on Tuesday.

VNZ assesses the government valuation for all properties and the values are then used as the basis for most local government rates, but from July 2000, local authorities will be able to choose their own valuation provider, Delamere told a press conference.
"Contestability will be phased in during the two years preceding this date, with government valuations continuing to be provided at least until that time."
VNZ would not be privatised as that would be in breach of the coalition agreement, he said.
The move would result in improved efficiencies in VNZ and a competitive environment which would result in savings for local authorities and therefore positive flow-on effects for ratepayers.
